# SmartImgKit
> Free browser-based image, PDF and video tools. Everything runs locally in your browser — no uploads, no signup, no watermarks, and your files never leave your device.

## Main tools
- [Background Remover](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/background-remover): remove image backgrounds locally with on-device AI, straight to transparent PNG
- [Image Compressor](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/compressor): shrink JPG, PNG and WebP with a visible quality preview before you download
- [Image Resizer](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/resizer): resize by pixels or percentage, with presets for Amazon, Etsy and social platforms
- [Image Converter](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/converter): convert between JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC and more without uploading
- [Image Cropper](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/cropper): crop to free size or fixed ratios like 1:1, 4:3 and 16:9
- [Watermark](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/watermark): add text or logo watermarks, single images or whole batches
- [ID / Passport Photo](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/id-photo): crop to official sizes with the right head position and background
- [Product White Background](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/product-white-background): turn product shots into marketplace-ready white-background photos
- [Image Enhancer](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/image-enhancer): fix exposure, sharpness and color in one pass
- [Face Blur](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/face-blur): blur or pixelate faces before sharing photos publicly
- [Photo Restoration](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/photo-restoration): revive old, faded or scratched family photos in the browser
- [OCR](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/ocr): extract text from images without sending them to any server
- [QR Code Generator](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/qr-code-generator): create QR codes with custom colors and download as PNG or SVG
- [HEIC Converter](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/heic-converter): open iPhone HEIC photos and convert them to JPG or PNG
- [Image Upscaler](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/image-upscaler): enlarge photos 2x-4x with on-device AI upscaling

## PDF tools
- [Image to PDF](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/image-to-pdf): combine photos into a single PDF, page order included
- [Excel to PDF](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/excel-to-pdf): convert spreadsheets to clean PDF documents
- [Word to PDF](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/word-to-pdf): turn DOCX files into PDFs locally
- [PDF Merge](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/pdf-merge): merge multiple PDFs with drag-and-drop ordering
- [PDF Split](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/pdf-split): split one PDF into separate pages or ranges
- [PDF Compress](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/pdf-compress): reduce PDF file size before emailing or uploading
- [PDF to Image](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/pdf-to-image): export PDF pages as PNG or JPG
- [PDF to Word](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/pdf-to-word): convert PDF text back into editable DOCX

## Batch and bulk
- [Bulk Processor](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/bulk-processor): compress, resize and convert hundreds of files in one queue
- [Batch Background Remover](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/batch-background-remover): strip backgrounds from a whole folder of product photos at once

## Video tools
- [Video Compressor](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/video-compressor): shrink video files locally before sharing
- [Video to GIF](https://smartimgkit.com/tools/video-to-gif): turn short clips into looping GIFs

## Guides
- [Amazon product image requirements](https://smartimgkit.com/blog/amazon-product-image-requirements-guide): size, background and format rules for Amazon listings
- [Etsy product photo requirements](https://smartimgkit.com/blog/etsy-product-photo-requirements): what Etsy expects from listing photos
- [Background removal: complete guide](https://smartimgkit.com/blog/remove-background-complete-guide): methods, tools and pitfalls explained
- [Image compression 101](https://smartimgkit.com/blog/image-compression-101): how compression works and when files lose quality
- [HEIC to JPEG conversion guide](https://smartimgkit.com/blog/heic-to-jpeg-conversion-guide): why iPhone photos are HEIC and how to convert them
